behavior_changes: uc.quality.strict_targets now resolves the revenue type set by following the CI workflow's delegation to tools/pre_push_gate.py (AST-read, never executed); the workflow is no longer required to inline 'python -m mypy'. Filing/wiki keep their inline workflow definition. The resolved revenue set is still exactly the 7 frozen files.

uc.quality.compute_baseline reports absent scope instead of raising: a sibling repository or an unresolvable git subtree yields {'status':'not_available','scope':...} (product_tree -> None plus product_tree_scopes), never a fabricated zero set and never a copy of revenue's set. A revenue repository that IS present but unreadable yields status='error' and becomes a failure.

uc.quality.verify now returns FAILURES only (closed set: invalid schema/unit config, unreadable in-scope revenue inputs, unreadable codegraph artifact). Coverage floors, complexity maxima, frozen allowlists, dead-caller counts, product-tree drift, sibling HEADs and old workflow text moved to uc.quality_report diagnostics and can no longer block.

New uc/quality_report.py exposes build_report(root, frozen, run_types=False) -> {schema_version, unit, root, failures, diagnostics, scope, baseline}, run_probe(cmd) which judges a real process ONLY by return code (exit 2 with no 'FAILED' text is a failure), and type_check_command().

uc.manifest.verify default flipped to check_mtime=False (SHA-256 + size). New mtime_diagnostics() returns the same differences as non-fatal notes. Path-escaping entries (absolute, drive-relative, '..') are rejected; a missing/non-JSON/schema-less manifest raises ManifestError instead of a raw traceback. Verification is read-only and never repairs.

uc/cli: all five '--mtime' flags and _require_no_drift default to 'off'; 'manifest-verify' prints OK plus up to 5 'NOTE: mtime drift ... (diagnostic only; --mtime strict enforces)' lines; ManifestError exits 1 cleanly; new 'quality-report --root --baseline --json --run-types' runs from isolated explicit inputs and writes zero files; 'quality-verify' prints QUALITY-NOTE diagnostics (never an exit gate) and QUALITY-VIOLATION failures (exit 1).

tools/sync_installations.ROOT_DIRECTORIES dropped 'tests' -> the package is now the runtime closure (3 root files + agents/config/references/scripts = 75 files). installation_diff compares only the owned runtime (residue/user files are neither drift nor a usage permit). sync_installation stages under a tmp dir and swaps files one by one, preserving unknown files, user configuration, output and old repository-only residue; no whole-directory replacement.

installation_actions: 1) Land W1 (drop 'tests' from scripts/revenue_forecast.py _root_directories) before any --apply, otherwise the --version identity check diverges.

2) Then run 'python tools/sync_installations.py' (read-only) to confirm the owned runtime matches ~/.agents, ~/.codex and the ~/.claude -> ~/.agents symlinked target (already deduplicated by unique_destinations).
3) Only then 'python tools/sync_installations.py --apply': the new targeted sync updates owned files and preserves unknown files, user configuration and output.
4) Optionally delete the now-unowned tests/ residue in each installation explicitly; the checker will not treat it as drift either way.
